memoryBuilder.verseText: God said: 'A King from your family will reign for ever.'

sequence.prompt: What happened the night God made His promise? Put it in order.

items.label: David looked at his fine cedar house
David said: 'I will build God a house'
God sent Nathan with a message
God promised a King who reigns for ever

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: It never empties — Jesus fills it
Because He is faithful, not because David was good

application.question: David sat down in wonder and said, 'Who am I?' What promise of God do you want to thank Him for?

options.label: God will never stop loving me

application.followUp: David offered God a house; God gave David a family with a King in it who would never stop being King. And He made that promise to a man He had already forgiven. Jesus reigns for ever.
